title: Posttherapeutic biomarker expression in mCRC patients with liver metastasis” The PRO-MARKER observational study
summary:
circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) offers a more sensitive method of detecting tumor disease than imaging or other traditional methods.
Monitoring of tumor response using blood tests and combined imaging methods will be demonstrated.
conditions: Secondary malignant neoplasm of respiratory and digestive organs

interventions.name: As this is an observational study only there are no additional risks for the patient. The treatment is chosen individually for the patient and takes place independently of the study presented here, which merely accompanies the therapy. Except for the additionally drawn blood during routine blood dra

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Histologically proven mCRC
• Patients with liver dominant metastatic CRC 
• Inclusion after full resection or local ablation of liver metastases 
• ECOG 0-2
• Limited extrahepatic metastases
Exclusion criteria:
• Life expectancy ≤3 months
• Known liver cirrhosis
